notes.title: Update notes 202506011830
notes.notes:
- Preparation of the second event of the ander4games series 2025.
- Incorporation of "1 vs 1" duels without lane separation.

* The tracks ending in OPEN have this feature.
* You face repetitions of real opponents.
* In this first version, the opponent follows his firm line. This means:
[olist]
 - Don't go "to the crash". You will lose every time.
 - When overtaking the opponent, keep your distance. If he catches up with you, he won't stop.
 - Look for gaps. There are opponents who offer you some opportunities. Take advantage of them.
[/olist]

This mode, along with others that we are developing, will become part of a separate and more "Simcade" product.

- Progressive (internal) incorporation of new evolution of physics.

notes.title: UPDATE NOTES 202504161630
notes.notes:
UPDATE NOTES

Desert stages. 

- Completion of 6 desert stages of 30 to 35 km. 1 for training and 5 for challenges and championships.
	- Voice commands. Workshop option. English and Spanish. Tutorial.
	- New fairplay controls.
	- More co-pilot voices. Guidance help when you lose your way. By voice or by text, according to the user's choice.
(These aids are subject to user approval. They have been tested intensively, but unforeseen circumstances may occur, so we will adapt to user feedback)

Performance parameters

- A new parameter has been added for lighting. With these values you can increase the performance very significantly.

Fixes

- When exiting a stage and going to the main menu again, "rubbish" would accumulate and slowly slow down the main menu. This has been fixed.

Preparing next update for the release of SIM SPORTS RAID "THE CHALLENGES"

- More English course voices.
	- Full activation of the anti-cheat system.

- The internal device detection system has been modified.
- A help sentence has been added to the axes selection process.
